title: WOMEN IN BLUE | Team India women's cricket anthem (ÆTHER) | a fan tribute
description:
Dust on the pitch where the old doubts lay. Blue in our blood, we were born for this day.

Women in Blue: an original ÆTHER anthem for the India women's cricket team, the 2025 World Cup champions. With thanks to the legends Mithali Raj and Jhulan Goswami.

A fan tribute. Not affiliated with or endorsed by BCCI, ICC or the players. Music is original (AI-assisted). Photos are free-licence files from Wikimedia Commons, credited below. Players with no free photo in the India jersey are shown by name on a real India shirt (museum photo by DesiBoy101, CC BY 4.0, name changed). CC BY-SA photos are adapted, so this video's visuals are shared under CC BY-SA 4.0.
